title: keel project configuration
description: The layered project configuration: .keel/config.yaml (team, Board-owned) and .keel/local.yaml (personal, gitignored). Layers merge in the order package defaults (config/keel.defaults.yaml), team, personal: tables deep-merge, arrays of objects keyed by id (or runtime) replace whole entries, and unknown keys are errors at every level. Every key is optional in a layer. Neither file ever holds provider values or secrets; provider routing lives in the Board-approved .keel/routing.yaml as environment variable NAMES only.

backend.description: auto selects jj only when every jj precondition holds (jj >= 0.45.1 feature-probed, colocated repository, no LFS, submodule or filter, and jj_opt_in true); git alone is always sufficient.

trunk.description: Trunk branch name, for example main.

remotes.description: Configured remote names the Steward snapshots with a read-only git ls-remote before and after each run.

jj_opt_in.description: Board opt-in to the jj enhancement backend.

workspace_root.description: Directory outside the repository that holds the planning, task and verify worktrees and the per-run directories (_runs/<RUN>/). A relative value resolves against the repository root; the default is ../<repo>.ws/.

since.description:
Trace epoch commit, set once by keel init. History before it is adopted, never guessed; the trace check covers merge-base(trunk, keel/

/main)..tip and history after this commit.

patch.description: Patch-track limits. A change above any limit is classified feature or higher, at intake and by the submit-time ratchet.

max_files.description: Maximum changed files for a patch (default 5).

max_loc.description: Maximum changed lines for a patch (default about 100).

protected_globs.description: Paths whose touch raises the track and needs a per-change contract approval.

max_top_level_dirs.description: Path fallback of the ratchet while no index is available: the track rises when changed paths span more top-level directory mappings than this (default 1).

commands.description: Declared project commands. Engineers may run them in their worktree (this produces no evidence); gates run the ones listed under gates; only the Steward runner's executions count as evidence.

gates.description: Per-gate settings keyed by gate name.

caps.description: Caps and thresholds. config/keel.defaults.yaml states a reason for each default.

max_parallel.description: Default and maximum wave width (default 3). Width above 1 on the feature track needs plan approval.

ack_attempts.description: ACK attempts per run before blocked(ack_mismatch) (default 2: one success-shaped retry).

fix_rounds.description: Fix rounds before blocked(non_convergence) (default 5); the review check caps review rounds at the same number.

resume_rounds.description: Fix rounds that resume the same engineer before a fresh engineer one tier up takes over (default 3).

review_focus_max.description: Maximum review focus items per work order (default 5), enforced by the plan gate check plan.review-focus.

handbook_block_bytes.description: Byte budget of the managed AGENTS.md block (default 8192).

handbook_chain_bytes.description: Byte budget of the whole AGENTS.md chain (default 32768).

lease_seconds.description: Claim lease length; keel audit re-queues a task whose lease expired.

cancel_grace_seconds.description: Grace period between closing a child's stdin and the forced kill on cancellation.

submit_payload_bytes.description: Size cap of one keel api or keel_submit payload, checked before the outbox drop is written (default 65536).

brief.description: Brief byte budgets. ACC items and must and must_not obligations are never truncated; an over-budget brief means the task must be split.

runtimes.description: Per-runtime brief byte budgets, keyed by runtime.

element_brief_bytes.description: Target size of the element brief section (2-4 KiB).

budget.description: Budget settings. Budgets themselves live in goals, plans and work orders.

warn_at_percent.description: Budget warning threshold in percent (default 80); blocked(budget) applies at 100.

backend.description: Index backend behind the IndexProvider port. heuristic is advisory only; none is an honest 'no index'. With heuristic or none, doctor reports the architecture checks as inert.

scip_index.description: Path of the user-provided index.scip when backend is scip.

unknown.description: Policy for an 'unknown' arch check result. default: it blocks on the system track, or when rules.yaml has rules reaching the affected elements, and is advisory otherwise; block: it always blocks. Only a Board override lifts a block; settings can tighten the policy, never loosen it.

board.description: Board member settings for keel approve. Meant for the personal layer .keel/local.yaml; a team-layer value applies to everyone who does not override it.

approver.description: The name recorded as approver in every approval record this user confirms. A declared local identity, not an authenticated one; when unset, keel approve asks for it at confirmation.

policy.description: Name of a Board-approved standing land policy in .keel/policies/, or null to require a land approval for every land.

gateSettings.description: Per-gate settings. They can add work to a gate but cannot switch a built-in check off: every check fails closed.

commands.description: Ids of declared commands this gate runs in addition to its built-in checks; only the submit and verify gates run declared commands, recorded as the checks submit.commands and verify.commands with a denominator (docs/11-verification.md); the frame gate check frame.schema refuses a non-empty list on other gates.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the gate's commands.
